latest.title: Endpoint Mapping Properties of Wave Operators for Two-Dimensional Schrödinger Operators
latest.abstract: We establish sharp endpoint mapping properties for the wave operators $W_\pm(H,-Δ)$ of two-dimensional Schrödinger operators $H=-Δ+V$ with real-valued decaying potentials $V$. Together with the known non-endpoint $L^p$ theory, our results give a complete classification of the $L^p$ mapping properties of the two-dimensional wave operators, and reveal an unexpected reversal of the usual threshold paradigm at the endpoints $p=1$ and $p=\infty$. When zero is a regular point of $H$, the wave operators fail to be bounded on $L^1(\mathbb{R}^2)$ and on $L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^2)$, but they satisfy the atural substitute estimates of Calderón--Zygmund type: $$ L^1(\mathbb{R}^2)\longrightarrow L^{1,\infty}(\mathbb{R}^2),\ \ \ \mathcal{H}^1(\mathbb{R}^2)\longrightarrow L^1(\mathbb{R}^2),\ \ \ L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^2)\longrightarrow \mathrm{BMO}(\mathbb{R}^2). $$ When zero is instead a threshold singularity of the first kind---an s-wave resonance with no other threshold obstruction, the wave operators are bounded on both endpoint spaces $L^1(\mathbb{R}^2)$ and $L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^2)$. Thus, in dimension two, an s-wave resonance improves the endpoint behavior of the wave operators, in sharp contrast with dimensions $n\ge3$, where the only regular case is the favorable one. We also determine the endpoint behavior in the remaining zero-energy spectral configurations of $H$. A p-wave resonance obstructs both the $L^1$- and the $L^\infty$-boundedness of the wave operators, while in the zero-eigenvalue case we obtain necessary and sufficient conditions for endpoint boundedness, expressed in terms of the presence of s- and p-wave resonances and of explicit second-order harmonic moment cancellations satisfied by the zero-energy eigenfunctions.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究 Schrödinger resolvent 的高能量与低能量估计，分别处理 regular point、first-kind/second-kind resonance 和零特征值。
latest.breakthrough: 正文的 Proposition 1.6 及低能量各节给出共振/零特征值情形的 resolvent 展开，并与高能量估计拼接。
latest.limitations: 低能量展开依赖加权空间、势的衰减和共振类型；不同 resonance 需分别满足文中 Fredholm 非退化条件。

steps.claim: 高能量区 resolvent 核具有统一衰减和加权估计。
steps.route: 第2–3节将自由 resolvent 写成 Hankel/Bessel 核，对振荡积分分区并用 stationary phase 控制高频项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11–20页，第2节 Free resolvent kernels；第3节 High-energy estimates。

steps.claim: regular point 与 first-kind resonance 下的低能量逆展开可控。
steps.route: 第4–5节把 resolvent 约化为 $M^{\pm }(\lambda )$ 的有限维矩阵逆，分别展开其正则部分与奇异核 $W_sing$，得到 Proposition 1.6 所需边界项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第21–37页，第4节 Low-energy properties；第5节 Theorems/Proposition 1.6 及 Subsection 5.3。

steps.claim: second-kind resonance 和零特征值情形由更高阶展开收束。
steps.route: 第6节继续展开 $M^{\pm }(\lambda )^{-1}$，分离零模并控制余项，和前述高能量界拼成完整 resolvent 描述。
steps.evidence: PDF 第37–45页，第6节 Low-energy estimates II: second-kind resonance and zero eigenvalue。
